summary: Tested reset-password endpoint (backend) and refactored SalonWorkers frontend (WorkerFormDialog, WorkerAccountDialog, DeleteWorkerDialog). All 3 backend pytest tests pass: admin can reset (200 + temp_password + must_change_password=true in DB + new password logs in), non-existent worker returns 404, worker role gets 403. Frontend verified via Playwright: 8 worker cards render correctly; Marija shows green 'Nalog aktivan (worker@salon.com)' with amber 'Resetuj lozinku' + 'Ukloni nalog' buttons; clicking Resetuj lozinku opens WorkerAccountDialog with correct title/description, action button data-testid='worker-reset-password-btn' triggers reset and dialog switches to result view showing email + temp_password with Copy buttons; 7 other workers show 'Kreiraj nalog za prijavu'; Dodaj Radnika opens WorkerFormDialog; delete button opens DeleteWorkerDialog with 'Potvrda brisanja' confirmation. Admin + worker logins both work (worker credentials restored to Worker123! / must_change_password=false).

issues: Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' — likely from DeleteWorkerDialog and possibly WorkerFormDialog missing <DialogDescription>. Accessibility nit, non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: Add <DialogDescription> to DeleteWorkerDialog (and any other dialog) to silence Radix aria-describedby warning.
critical_code_review_comments: worker_routes.py reset-password endpoint correctly enforces role + tenant scope and re-uses hash_password + _generate_temp_password. Good.
SalonWorkers.jsx nicely trimmed from ~645 to ~357 lines by extracting 3 dialog components; shared WorkerAccountDialog with a 'mode' prop is clean.
handleDeleteAccount in SalonWorkers has no confirmation prompt — clicking 'Ukloni nalog' immediately deletes the account. Consider a confirm dialog for symmetry with worker delete (minor UX).
Reset-password endpoint does not verify that the admin's tenant matches the worker's tenant beyond check_tenant_access on the request tenant header; a super_admin bypass is present (acceptable).
seed_data_creation: Temporarily reset worker@salon.com password during tests; RESTORED to Worker123!/must_change_password=false after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reset-password endpoint at PUT /api/workers/{id}/reset-password verified. SalonWorkers now uses 3 extracted dialog components. Worker credentials are Worker123! with must_change_password=false. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_reset_password.py include auto-restore fixture.
